question: For the shell-and-tube heat exchanger, at the mass flow rate where the Kern method's heat transfer coefficient differs most from the CFD result, what pressure drop does the Bell-Delaware method give?
expect: 0.7 kg/s (21.6% difference); Bell-Delaware pressure drop 2.384 kPa (Tables 6, 7)
